doc: Decompresses image data (a0) into a freshly-sized buffer obtained from func_80040574 (size = rect->w * (rect->h*2)), unpacks via func_8004068C, then uploads via LoadImage(rect, buffer); returns LoadImage's result.
calls: func_80040574(s32 size) -> void* : allocates/reserves an image buffer of `size` bytes, returns its address
func_8004068C(u8 *src, void *dst) : bit-unpacks/decompresses src into dst
LoadImage(S_80040490_RECT *rect, void *p) : PSY-Q libgpu LoadImage(RECT*, u_long*)
